limitations: These files are high-quality JPEG diagnostic copies, not original-BMP angle truth.
The set contains 25 frames but no capture record proving condition groups or repeat counts.
Original BMP data and explicit circular-angle truth remain required for formal accuracy acceptance.

fullFrame.interpretation: A raw circle estimate was present in every result, but adjacent fixtures pulled the full-frame estimate so no complete outer ring was accepted. Raw estimate availability is not a passed circle-quality result.

proven: The development ROI makes the inherited circle/ring chain usable on all 25 diagnostic JPEGs without changing the default configuration.
The ROI run deterministically extracts three candidates per frame and preserves fail-closed formal output.
Candidate-002 is prominence rank 1 in every frame and occupies three very tight image-angle modes, while candidate-001 and candidate-003 remain nearly fixed in image coordinates.
diagnosticInferenceOnly: The changing candidate-002 is more consistent with a rotating workpiece feature than the two image-frame-stable candidates.
Candidate-001 and candidate-003 are more consistent with fixed fixture, occlusion or contact boundaries than with the changing workpiece feature.
notProven: No candidate is proven to be drawing datum_primary, datum_secondary or target_left.
The three angle modes are not proven acquisition conditions or physical rotations.
The drawing's 85 deg plus-or-minus 5 deg is not proven to be an OK/NG tolerance or a mechanical correction target.
JPEG diagnostics do not establish angle accuracy.

minimumFieldQuestions: On the contact sheet, is the changing rank-1 candidate-002 a real housing slot in each of its three visible angle modes? If yes, label its drawing role in each mode.
Are candidate-001 near 31.58 deg and candidate-003 near 327.85 deg fixture/occlusion/contact boundaries rather than housing slots?
Is the drawing datum defined by the upper slot alone, the upper/lower slot centerline, or another reference?
Is 85 deg plus-or-minus 5 deg an inspection tolerance, a nominal used to calculate correction, or both as separate outputs?
Which capture records and original-BMP truth map the observed 20/2/3 frame modes to physical sample, condition and commanded angle?
